summary: Agent-created ideas are labelled 'User added' and a same-source cohort cannot be compared side by side or filtered
expected: `idea create` accepts an origin (generated_new/generated_derived) and source links; `idea list`/`/ideas` filter by source; an `idea compare --ids` command and `/ideas/compare` page show per-criterion scores, competition counts and relations for a chosen cohort without ranking the entire 238-idea portfolio.
actual: AS01–AS09 display origin 'User added' although an agent derived them from a transcript; `score rank` can only snapshot the whole scorecard; the ideas list has no source filter and there is no comparison view, so narrowing nine candidates must be done outside Foundry.
reproduction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/ideas/AS01 (eyebrow shows 'User added'); `foundry idea list --help` has no --source-id; `foundry score rank --help` has no idea filter.
impact: The digestible comparison the user asked for must be assembled in a report instead of being a reusable console view; origin labels misattribute authorship in the portfolio.
suggestion: Add origin/source options to `idea create --input`, a source filter on idea listing, and `idea compare` + `/ideas/compare`. Being implemented in package F02.
